text:
laura_customer: Hey team, running into a weird one — after switching our embeddings calls to use the int8 quant_profile for cost reasons, our embedding dims suddenly dropped from 1536 to 1024 in production. Users seeing mismatched vectors and downstream index failing. Request id: req_0a9f3c. Any ideas?
ellen_support: Sorry you're hitting this, laura. Can you paste the exact request payload (sanitized) and the error from the indexer?
laura_customer: Payload snippet: `POST /v1/embeddings { "model": "embedder-1536-v2", "input": [..], "quant_profile": "int8", "batch_size": 16 }` Error from FAISS: `RuntimeError: Incompatible vector dim: expected 1536 but got 1024`
sam_ml: Int8 quant shouldn't change the embedding dimensionality itself. Two quick hypotheses: 1) you're hitting a different model variant (a 1024-d model) because of model routing/fallback, or 2) a post-quantization postprocess (PCA/projection) is being applied in the serving path for that quant profile.
raj_infra: Also check batching — mixing small + large inputs in the same batch can trigger runtime variant selection if kernels don't support mixed sizes; we have a fallback that can pick a smaller-dim-compatible variant in rare cases.
laura_customer: We only changed quant_profile and credit usage dropped, so it feels linked to quantization. How do I confirm the variant?
essentially: deploy-bot posted: "deploy finished: embedder-1536-v2 @ ip-10-0-2-7, variants built: [fp16, int8-packed]"
ellen_support: @sam_ml can you confirm if any quant profile applies a projection for the int8-packed build?
sam_ml: Quick check in model onboarding notes: embedder-1536-v2 int8 build includes an optional residual folding that we use to improve latency that SHOULD preserve 1536 dims. But there was a bug in the packing step that accidentally triggered a 3:2 fold on one shard for batches > 8 producing 1024-length outputs. Reproduced locally with a stress-batch.
raj_infra: Repro steps I ran: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embedder-1536-v2","input":["a","b",..],"quant_profile":"int8","batch_size":16}'` then inspect `x-redwood-variant: embedder-1536-v2-int8-shard2` header. For batch_size 8 it returns 1536, for 16 it returned 1024.
laura_customer: Ugh — that matches our observations. We batch at 16 by default to save cost.
ellen_support: For now mitigation: 1) set `batch_size` <= 8 or 2) explicitly pin `variant` to the fp16/int8-packed that we know is stable, e.g. "variant": "embedder-1536-v2-int8-stable" in your payload, or 3) rollback to \`quant_profile": "fp16" until we patch.
sam_ml: Root cause: a sharded quant packing path had an incorrect channel grouping that reduced output channels when a boundary condition (batch_size > 8) triggered cross-shard concat shortcut. We're rolling a patch. ETA ~90 minutes for canary.
laura_customer: Fine to pin variant for us — what's the exact curl I should run to pin and verify dims?
essenital: Here is a quick pinned request: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embedder-1536-v2","variant":"embedder-1536-v2-int8-stable","quant_profile":"int8","input":["hello","world"],"batch_size":16}'` check response `embedding[0].length` should be 1536 and header `x-redwood-variant` should equal `embedder-1536-v2-int8-stable`.
raj_infra: Also you can add header `x-disable-auto-variant: true` to force no routing changes during your tests.
laura_customer: Trying now. Will report back in a few mins.
laura_customer: Confirmed — pinning variant returns 1536-length vectors. Thanks.
ellen_support: We'll keep you updated once the patch is live. I'll set up a short incident note and a rollback plan in case the canary introduces perf regressions.
sam_ml: Postmortem notes for customers: int8 quant itself is safe w.r.t dims. The issue was a rare sharded-packing bug triggered by specific batch sizes. We'll publish a short KB about how to pin variants and recommended batch sizes until fully patched.
laura_customer: Appreciate the fast response. Can you also flag billing — we were charged the lower int8 rate for the 1024 outputs but then indexing failed so we had hidden costs.
ellen_support: Copying billing to thread and created ticket BLG-1298. We'll reconcile charges for the failed indexing window. :white_check_mark:
sam_ml: Patch deployed to canary (embed-patch-193865) — monitoring metrics for output-dim mismatches.
raj_infra: FYI automated monitor rule `embed.dim.mismatch` fired 4 times during repro. Will keep it enabled until next-week stable.
laura_customer: Thanks all. Closing once billing resolved and patch is in prod. :pray:
